definitions.ask: Should `just lint` and `just check` fail when bob-cli emits rustc unused or private-interface warnings?

choices.label: Both clippy runs deny rustc unused/private-interface lints; clippy style lints stay warnings
Only fix today's warnings; nothing stops new ones from piling up silently

definitions.why: Nothing fails on these warnings today, which is how 40-plus of them piled up unnoticed
